summary.primaryMetric: cost axis: model calls, ATN interactions, transfer bytes and entry steps on all runs
summary.completionMetric: report-only audited two-phase completion; noninferiority claimed only when lower 95% bound > -delta

power.alphaAttainabilityStatement: 该 n 下双侧精确 McNemar 的 α=0.05 可达。

mcNemarDiagnostic.assumptions: All discordant pairs favor the same arm. Opposite discordance and multiplicity can only reduce power. This is a design calculation, not observed post-hoc power.
mcNemarDiagnostic.caution: 在 n=5 下，约 60 个百分点以下的效果不可靠区分；这不是一个可通过的能力闸门。
mcNemarDiagnostic.statement: The optimistic minimum detectable effect is a lower bound under the stated paired alternative.
mcNemarDiagnostic.use: Design diagnostic only; never used to support mechanism removal.

bestCaseSampleSize.caveat: Best case only. The registered paired score interval can require more seeds; discordant pairs can widen it. This bound is not substituted for the reported score interval.

costAxis.caveat: Normal-approximation design diagnostic at 80% power, not observed power. No unconditional claim of good power at n=12: paired cost variance is unknown.

nonInferiority.criterion: lower 95% bound > -margin (equivalently upper loss bound < margin)

planningAlternative.assumption: No true completion loss; q=1 is a stated planning scenario, not an estimate from five historical seeds. q=1 is deliberately demanding.

zeroDiscordanceInterval.criterion: lower 95% bound > -margin (equivalently upper loss bound < margin)
zeroDiscordanceInterval.assumptions: Independent paired seeds; nominal asymptotic score coverage, not an exact finite-sample interval. Zero discordances still have a nonzero-width interval. McNemar superiority p values do not decide removal.

nonInferiority.caveat: Power is an exact enumeration of the nominal score decision rule, not a claim that its finite-sample size is exact. Null-boundary rejection rates are reported by scenario.

maintainerDecision.rationale: 维护者选择为当前任务族简化接受最多25pp完成率损失；成本为主指标，完成率仅报告，接受低规划功效带来的不确定结论；n=14在最佳情形最小n=11上增加3个seed，不放宽损害边界。
maintainerDecision.evidence: 2026-10-07 当前会话：维护者明确选择 δ=25pp、n=14、四臂56次真实运行。

costCriterion.rule: Complete paired telemetry; adaptive-minus-ablation Student-t 95% lower bound > 0 and mean reduction >= 10% of paired adaptive mean.
costCriterion.rationale: A ten-percent reduction is a practical coordination reduction; all four cost quantities remain reported. Completion loss tolerance is evaluated separately.

design.completionMetric: report-only completion; lower 95% bound > -delta is required for any noninferiority claim
design.interaction: minimal versus adaptive; removal requires the joint ablation to pass
design.failurePolicy: Keep every failure and exception; no outcome-dependent retries or replacements.
design.unknownUsagePolicy: Never zero; preserve null and known/unknown coverage.

power.caution: 在 n=5 下，约 60 个百分点以下的效果不可靠区分；这不是一个可通过的能力闸门。
